commands.title: Open the Plan Check for This Task

enumDescriptions: The roadmap is designed at medium effort (about 40-70 s, in the background while you do the placement checks).
Higher effort for the roadmap call only: slower, and uses more of your plan.
deliberate.planEffort.description: Reasoning effort for the background roadmap call (PlanOutline).

deliberate.maxFollowUps.description: Maximum chained follow-up tasks on one concept. A follow-up is only created when the weakest task concept is below P 0.6 or has an active misconception.

deliberate.backgroundConcurrency.description: How many background preparation calls (roadmap, task prep, practice packs, hints) may run at once.

deliberate.backgroundCallsPerHour.description: Rolling hourly budget for background model calls (4 of them are reserved for hint ladders). Halved for the session after a usage-limit error.

_notes: deliberate.sprint (Ctrl+Alt+S) is already in pad.package.json; register it as coach.sprint().
Remove the old deliberate.speedDrill command (the LLM drill is gone; the sprint replaces it).
deliberate.maxFollowUps changes its default from 4 to 2 (replace the existing setting).
deliberate.polishReview is in buildloop.package.json; deliberate.jitAtom too.
